<quote by="Announced by Laughlan Vi Temeschwar, Master of Rings">To commission the weirwood bourse seat sinecure in Holberg at the request of the Sand Fishers and to create the Imperial title of the Red-Eyed Reaper of Three Hands' Stand to be appointed by League National Auction</quote>
==Overview==
* Creates a bourse seat in [[Holberg]] producing [[weirwood]] as per '''[[The_greatest_city_in_the_world#Flaxen_Pillars|The greatest city in the world]]''' wind of fortune
* Announcement by the [[Master of Rings]]
==Date==
* Winter 385YE
==Cost==
* Cost as per opportunity
* 20 wains of mithril
* 60 crowns
* Three months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Flaxen_Pillars}}
==Outcome==
* Now that work is complete, the [[Flaxen Pillars|Red-Eyed Reaper]] will be [[Auction_of_the_Seats#Additional_Titles|auctioned]] as a national Bourse seat of [[the League]] for the first time at the Spring Equinox 386YE for a reduced term
